blocks.orig: The Lake Manyara Tree Lodge is one of the most special and luxurious accommodations in the Tanzanian safari circuit. It consists of nine deluxe stilted treehouse suites set amongst an enchanting mahogany forest, right in the middle of Lake Manyara National Park. The commodious suites are fitted with cozy sitting rooms and vast beds in the adjourning bedrooms, while enormous outside decks bring you closer to nature’s bosom, as you nestle yourself right among the treetops. Soak in a freestanding tub encircled by forest views or zone out while taking an exhilarating shower outdoors. Overhead fans silently whirl, creating cool comfort. Mosquito nets adorning every bed make for a restful night’s sleep. And when you need a balance between nature and the surrounding world, WIFI is at your fingertips.
blocks.html: The Lake Manyara Tree Lodge ranks among the most special and luxurious places to stay on the Tanzanian safari circuit. It has nine deluxe treehouse suites on stilts, set in an enchanting mahogany forest right in the heart of Lake Manyara National Park. The roomy suites have cosy sitting rooms and huge beds in the adjoining bedrooms, while large outdoor decks bring you close to nature as you settle in among the treetops. Relax in a freestanding bath with forest views all around, or switch off under an invigorating outdoor shower. Ceiling fans turn quietly overhead to keep you cool. Every bed has a mosquito net, so you can sleep peacefully. And when you want to stay in touch with the outside world, WIFI is right there.
